name: Dizal (Jiangsu) Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Dizal (Jiangsu) Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, discovers, develops, and commercializes therapeutics for the treatment of oncology and hematologic disorders. Its assets include the ZEGFROVY, for the treatment of solid tumors; Gao Ruizhe to treat hematological malignancy, solid tumors, and immunological diseases; Birelentinib indicated for hematological malignancy; DZD2269, DZD1516, and DZD6008 for solid tumors; and GW5282 for hematological malignancy and solid tumors. Dizal (Jiangsu) Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2017 and is based in Shanghai, China.
